issues.description: Function name mismatch for the two-qubit gate helper in the tensor-network portion: the problem statement and solution refer to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate, but the template defines create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate instead. This naming difference is structural (not just a missing implementation) and will confuse students about which function to implement or call and may cause integration issues with provided examples/tests that expect create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the function in the template from create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (and keep its signature and behavior), or update the problem statement and solution to consistently use create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. Ensure the header comments and listed function names match the actual function name in the template.

issues.description: The tensor-network two-qubit gate factory is referred to as create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate in the problem statement and the solution, but the template defines it as create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. This mismatch of the same conceptual function name across artifacts can confuse students about which function they should implement and where, creating an unnecessary mapping burden between the assignment text, starter code, and intended solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (and update any internal references and docstrings) so the template, problem statement, and solution use the same identifier for this conceptual operation.
